# TenderX Nepal (टेन्डरएक्स नेपाल)

> Joint Venture Bid & Tender Workspace built for Nepali Contractors | Itahari, Nepal

TenderX Nepal (also known as TenderX, Tender X Nepal, tenderx itahari, टेन्डरएक्स, टेन्डरएक्स नेपाल, टेन्डर नेपाल) is the dedicated digital bid desk platform designed specifically for construction, civil engineering, and infrastructure contractors across Itahari, Koshi Province, and all of Nepal.

## Location & Identity
- **Name**: TenderX Nepal / TenderX (टेन्डरएक्स नेपाल)
- **Headquarters / Primary Region**: Itahari (इटहरी), Koshi Province, Nepal
- **Target Audience**: Nepali contractors, engineering firms, and joint venture (JV) partners participating in public e-GP (electronic Government Procurement) tenders.

## Core Pages & Endpoints
- [TenderX Nepal Homepage (English)](https://tenderxnepal.com/en): Digital bid desk and joint venture workspace for Nepali contractors.
- [TenderX Nepal Homepage (Nepali - नेपाली)](https://tenderxnepal.com/ne): नेपालका निर्माण व्यवसायीका लागि डिजिटल बिड डेस्क तथा संयुक्त उपक्रम (JV) कार्यस्थल।
- [Joint Venture Bid Workspace](https://tenderxnepal.com/en#workspace): Interactive bid workspace for partner shares, lead partner designations, and project details.
- [Bid Workflow & How It Works](https://tenderxnepal.com/en#how-it-works): 3-step structured journey from project details to final tender document generation.
- [Document Generator & Templates](https://tenderxnepal.com/en#documents): Standard Nepali e-GP joint venture agreements, bid submission letters, and partner authorisations.
- [Contractor Registration](https://tenderxnepal.com/en/register): Register company profile, tax clearances, VAT records, and credentials.
- [Contractor Login](https://tenderxnepal.com/en/login): Access active bid desks and saved joint venture bids.
- [XML Sitemap](https://tenderxnepal.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML sitemap.
- [Robots Policy](https://tenderxnepal.com/robots.txt): Crawler indexing policies and instructions.

## Search Aliases & Targeted Keywords
- **English**: tenderx, tenderxnepal, tender x nepal, tender x, tender nepal, nepal tender, nepal tenders, tender in nepal, tenders in nepal, tenderx itahari, tenderx itari, tender itahari, e-gp nepal tender, egp nepal, bolpatra nepal, bolpatra, joint venture bid workspace nepal, contractor tender software nepal, jv agreement nepal
- **Nepali (नेपाली)**: टेन्डरएक्स, टेन्डरएक्स नेपाल, टेन्डर एक्स नेपाल, टेन्डर नेपाल, नेपाल टेन्डर, बोलपत्र नेपाल, बोलपत्र, टेन्डरएक्स इटहरी, टेन्डर इटारी, टेन्डर इटहरी, ठेक्कापट्टा नेपाल, इ-जिपि नेपाल

## Core Capabilities
- **Joint Venture (JV) Bid Workspace**: Assemble partner shares, financial contributions, lead partner designations, and automated JV agreements.
- **Reusable Contractor Profiles**: Maintain verifiable company credentials, tax clearances, VAT records, equipment lists, and key personnel.
- **Document Preparation & Verification**: Centralize tender documents, bank guarantee formats, bid securities, and compliance matrices.
- **Bilingual Platform**: Native English and Nepali (नेपाली - Noto Sans Devanagari) support throughout the bid lifecycle.
